\section[keṭṭa]{\ta{கெட்ட} (keṭṭa) — bad}

\label{lesson:TA-C143-ketta}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Tamil for an elbow, then the Tamil for a thumb.

An adjective goes before the noun and does not change: \textbf{\ta{பெரிய} \ta{வீடு}}, \textbf{\ta{சிறிய} \ta{வீடு}}.
\end{quote}
